notes.title: Play the Kentum Demo NOW! 🌍 🚀
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce the launch of the KENTUM demo on Steam! Experience the first hours of this side-scrolling survival and base-building game set in a post-post-apocalyptic world.

Awaken from a 7,000-year slumber to find yourself alone in a strange and hostile world. You must scavenge for resources, craft machines, and build a self-sustaining home base to survive.

In this demo, explore the game’s first region, battle evolved predators, and adapt to dynamic weather events, low gravity, and ever-changing environments. You’ll need to create automation systems, optimize production chains, and craft everything you need to stay alive in this new, unknown world.

Key Features of the Demo:
[list]
[*] [b]Explore the First Region[/b]: Navigate the desolate landscapes of KENTUM’s post-apocalyptic world. From towering trash mountains to ruins, there's plenty of exploration to be had.
[*] [b]Craft & Build[/b]: Use advanced technology to create a self-regulating base. Craft machines, build farms, and design complex production chains to automate your survival.
[*] [b]Dynamic Weather & Seasons[/b]: Adapt to the hazardous climate of 10,000 AD with changing weather and seasons that affect gameplay.
[*] [b]Automated Systems[/b]: Build and optimize machinery, from conveyor belts to automated farms, to help you survive and thrive.
[*] [b]Diverse Flora & Fauna[/b]: Encounter strange lifeforms, evolved predators, and the unique wildlife of this distant future.
[*] [b]Craft Your Own Path[/b]: KENTUM is a systems-heavy game that lets you approach survival your way. Will you focus on automation? The choice is yours.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340148/4ee33a275d5e84bbc476858efe284e6da3d5b582.png[/img]

Don't miss your chance to play this demo and get a taste of what’s to come in the full game, releasing in 2025 on all major platforms!
